description: This Java class 'ThingAclValidator' provides validation for AccessControlList instances within the Eclipse Ditto project, ensuring they meet specific permission rules.

classes.name: ThingAclValidator
classes.description: A final, immutable class used to validate AccessControlList instances according to specific rules within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ThingAclValidator with a given AccessControlList. Throws NullPointerException if argument is null.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided AccessControlList contains at least one Authorization Subject with minimum required permissions.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an Optional string explaining the reason if validation fails.
